policy: Supplemental associations only where runners lack requirement metadata; no pass or qualification status.

live_backend.py.scope: Owned GTK text, clipboard, protected-field, pointer and stale-target assertions with persisted app state.
live_backend.py.limits: A single native fixture; not every text provider or desktop backend.

live_mcp.py.scope: Actual stdio initialization, discovery, input validation, actions, text and image metadata.
live_mcp.py.limits: Successful stream exchange and explicit assertions only; not fresh Mac/SSH discovery or protocol migration.

live_cancellation.py.scope: Protocol cancellation against a stopped owned accessibility provider, then late-effect observation.
live_cancellation.py.limits: Does not undo input delivered before cancellation or qualify SSH disconnection.

live_control.py.scope: Two independent MCP servers share cooperative pause/resume state.
live_control.py.limits: Does not stop arbitrary foreign clients or establish exclusive human input ownership.

live_mcp_controls.py.scope: Actual MCP protected input with hash-only oracle and explicit option selection.
live_mcp_controls.py.limits: Protected native GTK support only; not all password managers, browsers or secret-delivery mechanisms.

live_menu.py.scope: Owned GTK context menu and submenu outside the owner client rectangle.
live_menu.py.limits: No general tray, detached-menu or window-manager menu qualification.

live_waits.py.scope: Delayed GTK element/text changes and sampled pixel stability with cancellation/timeout cases.
live_waits.py.limits: Pixel stability is a bounded declared condition, not universal application idle.

live_input_guard.py.scope: Controller death while an owned pointer button is held; independent release checks.
live_input_guard.py.limits: Private display and owned input only; cannot identify a concurrent human holding the same button.

live_keyboard_guard.py.scope: Native layout/modifier planning and held-key cleanup against independent X state.
live_keyboard_guard.py.limits: Only recorded layouts/states and tested failure points; not arbitrary XKB actions or IME composition.

live_keyboard_identity.py.scope: Same-process XID recreation must not receive stale key dispatch; independent input oracle.
live_keyboard_identity.py.limits: Keyboard injection target identity only; ordinary asynchronous EWMH commands have separate limits.

live_mcp_keyboard.py.scope: Actual MCP bounded repetition and malformed-count refusal with GTK text/navigation oracle.
live_mcp_keyboard.py.limits: Bounded explicit key repetitions, not human autorepeat timing across all applications.

live_pointer_guard.py.scope: Owned native click/wheel delivery and guard recovery with file/X-state oracles.
live_pointer_guard.py.limits: Discrete wheel/button behavior only; not smooth scrolling or every nested scroll container.

live_input_generation.py.scope: Owned X server replacement at the same display/authority path and generation-bound cleanup.
live_input_generation.py.limits: Controlled replacement, not all VM shutdown or SSH transport failure sequences.

live_session_state.py.scope: Read-only lock/screensaver hints from controlled services on a private D-Bus session.
live_session_state.py.limits: Does not lock a real desktop or prove inactive/unknown hints mean unlocked.

live_file_workflows.py.scope: Mousepad overwrite Cancel/Replace, unsaved close decisions and readonly target; independent bytes.
live_file_workflows.py.limits: One editor/version; no disk-full save or concurrent path substitution qualification.

live_thunar.py.scope: Owned Thunar create/rename/copy conflict/delete decisions with filesystem oracles.
live_thunar.py.limits: Private fixture files only; not every filesystem, trash integration or drag-and-drop mode.

live_interaction.py.scope: Window states, geometry, raise ordering/focus and close blocked by owned modal dialog.
live_interaction.py.limits: One Xfwm setup; numerical EWMH dispatch is asynchronous and not an atomic identity transaction.

live_mcp_applications.py.scope: Actual MCP application discovery/launch and cooperative pause with independent argument/window oracle.
live_mcp_applications.py.limits: Configured guest application metadata; not fresh Mac SSH onboarding.

live_terminals.py.scope: xterm/Xfce terminal paste/confirmation and interrupt behavior measured by passive PTY bytes/signals.
live_terminals.py.limits: No pasted shell execution; bindings and bracketed-paste behavior are terminal-specific. PRIMARY/TUI workflows are separate.
